records.case_definition: Exact source-label target and original ICD agreement reused from unambiguous reviewed ICD-10 national all-sex count category. Native monthly new notifications or source-verified table-specific weekly notifications. Cumulative, sex-specific and estimated measurements cannot supply incident case curves. Preserve source calendar, case definition, ICD label, explicit zeros and missingness; never sum states, strata, weekly/monthly/annual or reporting systems.
records.provenance_note: Multiple registered series are not declared safely additive. The compatibility curve uses one representative series; inspect source_series for every retained definition.
